title: 2018 YABANCI DİL BİLGİSİ SEVİYE TESPİT SINAVI (SONBAHAR DÖNEMİ) İNGİLİZCE

questions.questionText: 1. For smokers who are under increased pressure to give up smoking, one of the easiest ---- is that quitting smoking makes people more likely to put on weight.
questions.explanation: Sigarayı bırakma baskısı altındaki tiryakilerin en kolay 'bahanelerinden' (excuses) birinin, sigarayı bırakmanın kilo alma ihtimalini artırması olduğu belirtilmektedir.
options: A) incentives
B) attempts
C) purposes
D) excuses
E) features

questions.questionText: 2. The primary ---- of an organisation's accounting department are to process financial information and to prepare financial statements at the end of the accounting period.
questions.explanation: Bir organizasyonun muhasebe departmanının temel 'hedefleri / amaçları' (objectives) finansal bilgileri işlemek ve tabloları hazırlamaktır.
options: A) advancements
B) compensations
C) obstacles
D) objectives
E) classifications

questions.questionText: 3. Scholars and historians have offered ---- locations for the mythical island Atlantis even in the face of ---- scientific evidence that it does not exist.
questions.explanation: Atlantis için 'sayısız' (numerous) konum önerildiği ve bunun, adanın var olmadığına dair 'ezici / karşı konulmaz' (overwhelming) bilimsel kanıtlara rağmen yapıldığı ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) numerous / overwhelming
B) compelling / erroneous
C) ambiguous / identical
D) doubtful / refutable
E) separate / insufficient

questions.questionText: 4. The Big Bang theory is the explanation most commonly ---- by astronomers for the origin of the universe.
questions.explanation: Büyük Patlama (Big Bang) teorisi, evrenin kökeni için gökbilimciler tarafından en yaygın 'kabul gören' (accepted) açıklamadır.
options: A) discovered
B) accepted
C) regulated
D) conducted
E) influenced

questions.questionText: 5. The relationship between the two variables has been ---- studied for decades, but researchers still have a limited understanding of the link between the two.
questions.explanation: İki değişken arasındaki ilişkinin on yıllardır 'kapsamlı bir şekilde' (extensively) incelendiği ancak araştırmacıların hala sınırlı bir anlayışa sahip olduğu vurgulanmıştır.
options: A) severely
B) suspiciously
C) uniquely
D) extensively
E) instantly

questions.questionText: 6. Sense of control refers to the degree to which people believe that they can deliberately ---- desired outcomes and avoid undesirable ones in their environment.
questions.explanation: İstenen sonuçları kasıtlı olarak 'ortaya çıkarmak / meydana getirmek' (bring about) ve istenmeyenlerden kaçınmak anlamını veren phrasal verb 'bring about'tır.
options: A) fill out
B) bring about
C) switch off
D) turn down
E) hand over

questions.questionText: 7. For a long time, scientists ---- aware that the Earth's atmosphere is not static, but is in constant motion, producing areas of ever-changing pressure around the globe, but from 1700 onward, scientists ---- to discover how and why large-scale atmospheric movements occur.
questions.explanation: 'For a long time' (uzun zamandır) ifadesi günümüze kadar gelen süreci kapsadığı için Present Perfect (have been); 'from 1700 onward' ifadesi geçmişte bir başlangıç noktası verdiği için Simple Past (began) gerektirir.
options: A) had been / have begun
B) would have been / had begun
C) have been / began
D) would be / were beginning
E) were / would have begun

questions.questionText: 8. Science ---- our every question, but it ---- humanity's best tool yet for tackling our greatest challenges.
questions.explanation: Bilim her sorumuzu cevaplaya'mayabilir' (might not answer), ancak zorlukların üstesinden gelmek için hala en iyi aracımız 'olmaya devam ediyor' (remains).
options: A) may not answer / had remained
B) must not answer / has remained
C) should not answer / will remain
D) cannot answer / remained
E) might not answer / remains

questions.questionText: 9. Five of the Solomon Islands ---- whole by rising sea levels, ---- a glimpse into the future of other low-lying nations, such as the Netherlands and Italy.
questions.explanation: Adaların deniz seviyesinin yükselmesiyle bütünüyle yutulmuş olması güncel bir durumdur (have been swallowed), ve bu durum geleceğe dair bir bakış açısı 'sunmaktadır' (offering - participle clause).
options: A) are being swallowed / having offered
B) had been swallowed / being offered
C) will be swallowed / having been offered
D) were swallowed / offered
E) have been swallowed / offering

questions.questionText: 10. Research ---- the effects of media on children has primarily examined the issue ---- a developmental psychological perspective...
questions.explanation: Bir şeyin 'üzerindeki' etkileri inceleyen araştırma (Research on) ve konuyu belirli bir bakış açısın'dan' (from a perspective) incelemek edat uyumunu sağlar.
options: A) against / under
B) on / from
C) through / toward
D) in / beyond
E) at / over

questions.questionText: 11. Identifying the specific effects of beneficial microbes that thrive ---- the surface of our bodies and deep ---- our tissues, researchers are gaining a new view of how our bodies function.
questions.explanation: Vücudumuzun yüzeyi 'üzerinde' (on the surface) ve dokularımızın derinlikleri 'içinde' (within our tissues) yaşayan mikroplar anlatılmaktadır.
options: A) at / over
B) in / along
C) by / down
D) on / within
E) from / through

questions.questionText: 12. Most cheesemakers believe that the brilliant nuances of flavour found in raw milk, with its naturally present 'good' bacteria, simply cannot be duplicated in a pasteurised milk cheese ---- some well-respected cheeses, including British Stilton, are made only from pasteurised milk.
questions.explanation: Çiğ sütün lezzetinin pastörize sütte taklit edilemeyeceğine inanılmasına 'rağmen' (although), bazı saygın peynirlerin sadece pastörize sütten yapılması bir zıtlık oluşturur.
options: A) now that
B) after
C) although
D) because
E) only if

questions.questionText: 13. Surprisingly, the symbol for zero emerged later than the concepts for other numbers, and ---- the Babylonians used a symbol for zero, it was merely a placeholder and not used for computational purposes.
questions.explanation: Babilliler sıfır için bir sembol kullanmalarına 'rağmen' (even though), bunun sadece yer tutucu olması ve hesaplama amacıyla kullanılmaması zıtlık bağlacı gerektirir.
options: A) just as
B) as if
C) in case
D) because
E) even though

questions.questionText: 14. Studies have found that the effects of a cup of coffee or a glass of cola are noticeable after just 10 minutes ---- the peak caffeine concentration in the blood occurs after 45 minutes.
questions.explanation: Etkilerin sadece 10 dakika sonra fark edilebilmesi 'fakat / ancak' (but) kandaki en yüksek kafein yoğunluğunun 45 dakika sonra meydana gelmesi zıtlığını belirtir.
options: A) since
B) but
C) provided that
D) as
E) unless

questions.questionText: 15. Animals are hunted by humans ---- for their meat ---- for parts of their bodies that are used to create medicines, clothes, and jewellery.
questions.explanation: Hayvanlar insanlar tarafından 'sadece' etleri için 'değil aynı zamanda' (not only / but also) ilaç, kıyafet ve mücevher yapılan vücut parçaları için de avlanırlar.
options: A) neither / nor
B) such / that
C) not only / but also
D) the more / the more
E) as / as

questions.questionText: 16. ---- its notoriety as a naval weapon, the modern torpedo was developed in landlocked Austria, or rather in what was then the Austrian Empire stretching down to the Adriatic.
questions.explanation: Bir donanma silahı olarak kötü şöhretine 'rağmen' (Despite), denize kıyısı olmayan (landlocked) Avusturya'da geliştirilmesi bir tezat oluşturur.
options: A) Along with
B) Instead of
C) Despite
D) Because of
E) Thanks to

questions.questionText: 17. Sometimes when people assert that a language has no grammar, what they really mean is that there is no grammar book for that particular language. But the rules of a language (17)---- in the heads of speakers of that language.
questions.explanation: Bir dilin kurallarının o dili konuşanların kafasında 'var olduğu / bulunduğu' (exist) ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) alter
B) recover
C) endure
D) apply
E) exist

questions.questionText: 18. We know the rules are there (18)---- the way the speakers behave. They use similar structures...
questions.explanation: Konuşmacıların davranış biçimleri 'yüzünden / sayesinde / sebebiyle' (because of) o kuralların orada olduğunu biliyoruz.
options: A) because of
B) despite
C) contrary to
D) instead of
E) similar to

questions.questionText: 19. They use similar structures (19)---- similar events. If you hear the sentence...
questions.explanation: Benzer olaylar 'için' (for) benzer yapıları kullanırlar anlamı verilmek istenmiştir.
options: A) against
B) on
C) from
D) for
E) into

questions.questionText: 20. If you hear the sentence for "Give me some water." in a rarely spoken language such as Spelitzian, you can be pretty sure you can use the same pattern for "Give me some food.", (20)---- there are other possible patterns as well.
questions.explanation: Başka olası kalıplar 'olsa bile' (even if) aynı kalıbı yiyecek istemek için de kullanabileceğinizden emin olabilirsiniz.
options: A) provided
B) once
C) in case
D) because
E) even if

questions.questionText: 21. If there were not any patterns, people would not be able to communicate because they would have no way of knowing what other people meant (21)----.
questions.explanation: Diğer insanların ne 'söylemek' (to say) istediğini bilemeyecekleri için 'mean to say' kalıbı kullanılmıştır.
options: A) saying
B) to say
C) having said
D) being said
E) to have been saying

questions.questionText: 22. An electric car future is speeding closer - economic analysts project that a third of all automobiles could be battery-powered by 2040. Most of these vehicles (22)---- large lithium batteries, which prompts worries about whether the world's lithium supply can keep up.
questions.explanation: Bu araçların çoğunun büyük lityum pillerine 'bel bağlayacağı/dayanacağı' (rely on) ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) call off
B) rely on
C) take in
D) go through
E) cut down

questions.questionText: 23. (23)----, another element, cobalt, is a bigger concern. The best lithium battery cathodes (negative electrodes) all contain cobalt, and its production is limited.
questions.explanation: Lityum arzıyla ilgili endişelerden bahsedildikten sonra, 'Ancak' (However) kobaltın daha büyük bir endişe kaynağı olduğuna geçiş yapılmıştır.
options: A) Consequently
B) In conclusion
C) At least
D) However
E) Otherwise

questions.questionText: 24. Even with a very conservative estimate of 10 million electric vehicles (EVs) in 2025, the demand (24)---- cobalt that year could reach 330,000 metric tons...
questions.explanation: Kobalt 'için' talep (demand for) edat kullanımı gereğidir.
options: A) for
B) into
C) about
D) from
E) to

questions.questionText: 25. Recycling lithium batteries is complicated and rarely done. Even with higher rates and cheaper processes, recycling (25)---- the use of lithium batteries until 10 or more years after mass-market penetration of EVs.
questions.explanation: Geleceğe yönelik bir tahmin ve öngörü yapıldığı için, geri dönüşümün pillerin kullanımını 10 yıl sonrasına kadar 'azaltmayacağı' (will not reduce) ifade edilir.
options: A) has not reduced
B) will not reduce
C) does not reduce
D) did not reduce
E) is not reducing

questions.questionText: 26. But newer cathode chemistries offer hope. (26)---- recently developed nickel-rich and cobalt-free formulations, cobalt demand may decline.
questions.explanation: Yeni geliştirilen zengin nikel içeren ve kobaltsız formülasyonlar 'sayesinde' (Thanks to) kobalt talebi düşebilir.
options: A) Rather than
B) Similar to
C) In comparison with
D) As opposed to
E) Thanks to

questions.questionText: 27. ----, but the creation of genetic techniques to safely halt or reverse age-related conditions in humans has so far proven improbable.
questions.explanation: Genetik tekniklerle yaşa bağlı durumları güvenli bir şekilde durdurmanın veya geri çevirmenin şimdiye kadar olanaksız olduğunun kanıtlanmasıyla uyumlu zıtlık: 'Bir organizmada belirli genleri manipüle etmenin yaşlanmayı yavaşlatabileceği uzun zamandır bilinmektedir' (It has long been known that...).
options: A) Some researchers have doubts whether a new genetic technique could be developed as a first step towards the medical world's fabled 'elixir of youth'
B) It has long been known that manipulating certain genes in an organism can slow ageing and extend its lifespan
C) More proof will be needed before new genetic treatments using stem cells can be promoted as the key to turning back the clock on old age
D) Ageing of the body is a dynamic process, as often reported by a number of researchers
E) The efficacy of new methods utilised to prevent ageing is still questionable

questions.questionText: 28. Because bodybuilders exert large amounts of energy, ----.
questions.explanation: Vücut geliştiriciler büyük miktarda enerji harcadıkları için (Because), 'metabolizmaları genellikle ortalama bir insandan günde daha fazla kalori gerektirir' (their metabolism generally requires more calories).
options: A) they are judged on the physical appearance of their muscles and encouraged to focus on body image
B) they try to achieve the body type that will help them be effective competitors in their sport
C) bodybuilding is the development of the physique through exercise, often for competitive purposes
D) their metabolism generally requires more calories per day than the average person
E) bodybuilding is an activity that involves weight training in order to build muscle mass

questions.questionText: 29. While people can generally cough voluntarily, ----.
questions.explanation: İnsanlar genellikle istemli olarak öksürebilseler de (While), 'öksürük genellikle hava yolundaki tahriş edici maddeleri temizlemek için yapılan bir refleks eylemidir' şeklinde tamamlanmalıdır (OCR kaynaklı hatalı şık gösterimi, en doğru bağlam refleks veya gün içi istemsiz temizlik üzerinedir).
options: A) infectious viruses can be easily transmitted between individuals through coughing
B) a cough is usually a reflex action to clear irritants off the airway
C) environmental pollutants, such as cigarette smoke and dust can also cause a cough
D) the cough that accompanies a cold usually lasts one to two weeks
E) vitamins and minerals may be helpful in treating conditions that lead to coughs

questions.questionText: 30. When mental disorders are accompanied by physical decline, ----.
questions.explanation: Zihinsel bozukluklara fiziksel gerileme de eşlik ettiğinde, 'hastaneye yatış veya bakım tesislerine yerleştirilme riskinin arttığı' yönündeki tıbbi sonuç mantıklıdır.
options: A) older adults have been found to be relatively active in their 80s and 90s
B) it is important to note that older adults vary in terms of their physical and mental conditions
C) there is an increased risk of hospitalisation and placement in care facilities
D) physical decline is associated with causing a number of mental disorders among older adults
E) mental health problems such as depression are not a natural consequence of growing older

questions.questionText: 31. Unless there are substantial changes in the ways that humans affect ecosystems, ----.
questions.explanation: İnsanların ekosistemleri etkileme biçimlerinde önemli değişiklikler olmadıkça (Unless), 'yakın gelecekte biyoçeşitlilikte çok daha büyük kayıplar olacaktır' cümlesi anlamı doğru bir şekilde tamamlar.
options: A) we have already caused permanent losses in global biodiversity
B) our knowledge of Earth's species is still incomplete
C) there could be as many as 30-50 million species on Earth
D) there will be much larger losses of biodiversity in the near future
E) the scale by which we consider biodiversity ranges from local to global

questions.questionText: 32. ----, our very lives depend on it to sustain agriculture and to keep our bodies healthy.
questions.explanation: 'Soğuk hava bize rahatsızlık verebilse veya daha ciddi sağlık koşullarına neden olabilse de (While)', tarımı sürdürmek ve bedenlerimizi sağlıklı tutmak için bizzat yaşamlarımız ona [havaya] bağlıdır.
options: A) Since scientists have long struggled to comprehend the complexities of the weather
B) Just as the Earth's atmosphere would remain stagnant without weather
C) While cold weather might cause us discomfort or even more severe health conditions
D) Given that humanity has, indeed, changed the weather
E) If predicting the weather is still, in many ways, a haphazard occupation

questions.questionText: 33. ---- the nations of Europe raced to colonise the continent.
questions.explanation: 'Teknolojik gelişmeler 19. yüzyılın sonlarında Afrika'nın iç kısımlarını kolayca erişilebilir hale getirdiğinde (When)', Avrupa ülkeleri kıtayı sömürgeleştirmek için yarıştı.
options: A) Given that almost all European interaction with Africa took place along the coasts until the 18th century
B) Because African responses to the challenge of European imperialism were complex
C) Even if colonial administrations enticed or coerced Africans into producing goods for export
D) When technological advances made Africa's interior readily accessible in the late 19th century
E) Despite several factors that drove the European scramble for Africa in the 18th century

questions.questionText: 34. ---- the Romans were very careful about the way they dressed.
questions.explanation: 'Romalı kıyafetleri nispeten basit olmasına rağmen (Although)' ya da statü göstermek için tasarlanmış olsa da, Romalılar nasıl giyindiklerine çok dikkat ederlerdi.
options: A) Even though their clothing was relatively simple
B) As most of what we know about Roman clothing comes from written sources
C) While the Romans were not the first major society to wear seasonal clothing
D) Because their empire grew so great and took them to very different climates
E) Whereas wealthy Romans had slaves to help choose their clothing

questions.questionText: 35. ----, the ethnic characteristics and traditions of the Balkan Peninsula's food culture have been well preserved.
questions.explanation: Son birkaç yüzyılda doğu etkisi çok güçlü olmasına rağmen (Even though), Balkan Yarımadası yemek kültürünün etnik özellikleri ve gelenekleri iyi korunmuştur.
options: A) Provided that it displays both Asian and western European influences
B) Even if meat might not have played a central role in the past
C) Even though the eastern influence has been very strong in the last several centuries
D) As long as its food culture is shaped by the historic, social and climatic elements
E) While the use of numerous spices constitutes the basics of its cuisine

questions.questionText: 36. The Sung dynasty Chinese (AD 960-1279) had the technology to make rockets, ----.
questions.explanation: Sung hanedanlığı döneminde Çinlilerin roket yapma teknolojisi vardı, 'ancak bunu yaptıklarına dair kesin bir kanıt yoktur' (but there is no definitive evidence that they did so).
options: A) so the first European picture of a rocket was made in 1400
B) thus it was occasionally used as a weapon by Europeans
C) because the earliest European recipe for black powder appeared in 1265
D) but there is no definitive evidence that they did so
E) as the origin of the rocket is shrouded in mystery

questions.questionText: 37. Intelligence, which has been open to a range of definitions due to its abstract nature and thus has become a controversial topic, is usually regarded as a measure of cognitive skills and the ability to solve problems.
questions.explanation: 'Soyut doğasından dolayı bir dizi tanıma açık olan ve bu yüzden tartışmalı bir konu hâline gelen zekâ, genellikle bilişsel becerilerin ve problem çözme yeteneğinin bir ölçütü olarak görülmektedir' şeklindeki D seçeneği, tüm relative clause (which) ve bağlaç (due to, thus) yapılarını eksiksiz karşılar.
options: A) Çoğunlukla bilişsel becerilerin ve problem çözme yeteneğinin bir ölçütü olarak görülen zeka, soyut doğasından ötürü bir dizi tanıma açık olduğu için tartışmalı bir konu haline gelmiştir
B) Zeka, soyut doğası gereği bir dizi tanıma açık olup tartışmalı bir konu haline gelse de genelikle bilişsel becerilerin ve problem çözme yeteneğinin bir ölçütü olarak görülmektedir.
C) Genellikle bilişsel becerilerin ve problem çözme yeteneğinin bir ölçütü olarak görülen zekânın soyut doğası nedeniyle bir dizi tanıma açık olması onu tartışılan bir konu hâline getirmiştir.
D) Soyut doğasından dolayı bir dizi tanıma açık olan ve bu yüzden tartışmalı bir konu hâline gelen zekâ, genellikle bilişsel becerilerin ve problem çözme yeteneğinin bir ölçütü olarak görülmektedir.
E) Zekâ bilişsel becerilerin ve problem çözme yeteneğinin bir ölçütü olarak görülmüş, soyut doğası gereği bir dizi tanıma açık olmuş ve bundan dolayı tartışmalı bir konu haline gelmiştir.

questions.questionText: 38. World War I was supposed to be the war to end all wars, but defeated countries were faced with harsh peace terms, which led to the outbreak of World War II.
questions.explanation: İlk cümledeki 'was supposed to be' yapısı 'zannediliyordu/bekleniyordu' şeklinde, 'which led to the outbreak' yapısı ise 'ki bu da ... patlak vermesine/ortaya çıkmasına neden oldu' şeklinde çevrilir. C şıkkı bu yapıyı eksiksiz aktarır.
options: A) I. Dünya Savaşı'nın tüm savaşlara son verecek savaş olacağı düşünülüyordu, fakat yenilen ülkelerin ağır barış koşullarıyla karşı karşıya kalması sonucunda II. Dünya Savaşı gerçekleşti.
B) Tüm savaşlara son verecek savaş olacağı zannedilen I. Dünya Savaşı'nda yenilen ülkeler ağır barış koşullarıyla karşı karşıya kaldı ve bu durum II. Dünya Savaşı'nın ortaya çıkmasına neden oldu.

C) 1. Dünya Savaşı'nın tüm savaşları sona erdirecek savaş olacağı zannediliyordu, ancak yenilen ülkeler ağır barış koşullarıyla karşı karşıya kaldı, ki bu da II. Dünya Savaşı'nın ortaya çıkmasına neden oldu.

D) II. Dünya Savaşı'nın gerçekleşmesine neden olan sey, 1. Dünya Savaşı'nın tüm savaşlara son verecek savaş olacağının düşünülmesine rağmen yenilen ülkelerin ağır barış koşullarıyla karşı karşıya kalmasıydı.
E) I. Dünya Savaşı'nın tüm savaşları sona erdirecek savaş olacağına inanılsa da yenilen ülkelerin ağır barış koşullarıyla karşı karşıya kalması, li. Dünya Savaşı'nın ortaya çıkmasına neden oldu.

questions.questionText: 39. Today's urban developments, coupled with an increasing population, threaten many archaeological sites in Egypt.
questions.explanation: 'coupled with an increasing population' ifadesi 'artmakta olan nüfusla birlikte', ana fiil 'threaten' ise 'tehdit etmektedir' şeklinde çevrildiğinde C seçeneğindeki dizilim doğru yanıtı verir.
options: A) Günümüzdeki kentsel gelişmeler, nüfus artışının da etkisiyle birlikte, Mısır'daki birçok arkeolojik alan için tehdit oluşturmaktadır.
B) Mısır'daki birçok arkeolojik alan, günümüzdeki kentsel gelişmeler ve artmakta olan nüfus yüzünden tehdit altındadır.
C) Günümüzdeki kentsel gelişmeler, artmakta olan nüfusla birlikte, Mısır'daki birçok arkeolojik alanı tehdit etmektedir.
D) Günümüzdeki kentsel gelişmeler, nüfus artışını beraberinde getirerek Mısır'daki birçok arkeolojik alan için tehdit oluşturmaktadır.
E) Günümüzdeki kentsel gelişmelerin artmakta olan nüfusla desteklenmesi, Mısır'daki birçok arkeolojik alanı tehdit etmektedir.

questions.questionText: 40. Makro fotoğrafçılığın en önemli tekniklerini keşfetmek için, fotoğrafçılar bir bahçede ışık ve konumla çalışmalı ve ufak hareketlerle arka planın nasıl değiştiğini fark etmelidir.
questions.explanation: Türkçe cümlede geçen 'keşfetmek için' (To discover), 'çalışmalı' (should work) ve 'fark etmelidir' (notice) fiilleri E şıkkında İngilizce yapı ve zamanlarıyla tam karşılığını bulur.
options: A) The key techniques of macro photography include working with light and position in a garden, through which photographers can notice how the background changes with slight moves.
B) Discovering the key techniques of macro photography requires photographers to work with light and position in a garden and to notice how the background changes with their slight moves.
C) To notice the key techniques of macro photography, photographers may work with light and position in a garden and discover how the background changes in accordance with slight moves.

D) To discover the key techniques in macro photography, photographers need to work with different ranges of light and position in a garden and notice the changes in the background caused by slight moves.
E) To discover the key techniques of macro photography, photographers should work with light and position in a garden and notice how the background changes with slight moves.

questions.questionText: 41. Hastalığın biyolojik doğası kültürden kültüre değişmese de hastalıkların nasıl algılandığının ciddi bir biçimde değişiklik gösterdiğine dair net kanıtlar vardır.
questions.explanation: '...değişmese de' yan cümleciği (Although the biological nature of disease does not change...), 'net kanıtlar vardır' (there is clear evidence) ana cümlesiyle birleşerek D şıkkını oluşturur.
options: A) The biological nature of disease does not change from one culture to another, though we have clear evidence showing that how diseases are understood is dramatically different.
B) While the biological nature of disease differs slightly from one culture to another, there is dramatic variation in how diseases are understood, as shown by clear evidence.
C) Even if there is clear evidence suggesting that how diseases are understood varies dramatically from one culture to another, the biological nature remains constant.
D) Although the biological nature of disease does not change from one culture to another, there is clear evidence that how diseases are understood varies dramatically.
E) There is clear evidence suggesting that the biological nature of disease does not change, but how diseases are understood varies to a great extent from one culture to another.

questions.questionText: 42. Akademik başarısızlığın önlenmesi ciddi bir konudur çünkü akademik başarısızlığa uğrayan çocuklar yaşamları boyunca önemli sosyal ve ekonomik problemler yaşarlar.
questions.explanation: Türkçe cümlenin ilk kısmı 'Prevention of academic failure is a serious subject', sebep bildiren kısmı 'because children who fail academically experience significant social and economic problems throughout their lives' ile C seçeneğinde en doğru şekilde çevrilmiştir.
options: A) It is important that academic failure is prevented since children who fail academically are likely to suffer from significant social and economic problems throughout their lives.
B) Should academic failure not be avoided, which is a serious subject, children who fail academically face important social and economic problems throughout their lives.
C) Prevention of academic failure is a serious subject because children who fail academically experience significant social and economic problems throughout their lives.
D) As a subject, prevention of academic failure is serious because children who fail at school go through significant social and economic problems throughout their lives.
E) What makes prevention of academic failure a serious subject is that children who fail academically have significant social and economic problems throughout their lives.

questions.questionText: 43. There is a controversy about video games even among scientists because ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde 'Numerous studies about the effects of games on the brain have come up with conflicting results' denilerek, bilim insanları arasında video oyunlarının etkilerine dair neden tartışma olduğu (farklı çalışmaların çelişkili sonuçlar üretmesi) açıklanmıştır.
options: A) not many scientists have developed the suitable research design to investigate the issue
B) video games affect our brains in a number of negative ways
C) scientists are still waiting for convincing clinical testing
D) different studies have produced conflicting results / findings
E) there are not many changes in the brains of video game players

questions.questionText: 44. Why do online multiplayer games tend to be more addictive than others?
questions.explanation: Paragrafta, çevrimiçi çok oyunculu (multiplayer) oyunların bağımlılıkla en çok ilişkilendirilenler olmasının nedeni, 'sosyal etkileşimlerin (social interactions) tek başına bilgisayara karşı oynamaktan daha ödüllendirici olması' (involve communication between players) olarak verilmiştir.
options: A) They display more violence than other games.
B) They lead to more conflicting behaviours.
C) They help some regions of the brain get bigger.
D) They involve communication / social interactions between players.
E) They contribute more to the functioning of the brain.

questions.questionText: 45. Which of the following questions CANNOT be answered according to the passage?
questions.explanation: Pasaj video oyunlarının beyindeki etkilerini (bağımlılık riski, bilişsel eğitimi artırması vb.) araştırsa da, video oyunlarının negatif etkilerinden nasıl kaçınılacağına ('way to avoid the negative effects') dair bir cevap vermemektedir.
options: A) Is there a way to avoid the negative effects of video games?
B) Is there any research on the effects of video games on the brain?
C) Can video games help people socialise with others?
D) Can video games lead to better brain functioning?
E) Are there any disadvantages associated with video games?

questions.questionText: 46. What is the author's attitude towards video games?
questions.explanation: Yazar pasaj boyunca video oyunlarının hem bağımlılık gibi olumsuz yönlerini hem de beyni %100 kapasitede çalıştırarak bilişsel gelişimi destekleme gibi olumlu yönlerini tarafsızca (Objective) aktarmaktadır.
options: A) Sarcastic
B) Indifferent
C) Sceptical
D) Objective
E) Pessimistic

questions.questionText: 47. Which of the following is true about crop production according to the passage?
questions.explanation: Metinde kömürle çalışan elektrik santrallerinin kirleticiler kusarak duman oluşturduğu ve bunun da 'dört ana mahsulün (mısır, pamuk vb.) üretimini sınırlayacağı' (negatively impacting crop yields) belirtilmektedir.
options: A) The losses are insignificant since only four crops are affected.
B) Smog has no significant effect on crop production in the US.
C) If coal-fired power plant efficiency is improved, yields will increase dramatically.
D) Coal-fired power plants produce pollutants that form smog, thereby negatively impacting crop yields.
E) The losses will continue at the same pace even after implementing the Clean Power Plan.

questions.questionText: 48. According to the passage, in order to estimate crop production losses, the new research ----.
questions.explanation: Araştırma ekibinin mahsul üretim kayıplarının boyutunu, Clean Power Plan (Obama planı) gibi üç ülke çapında 'karşıt senaryo' üzerinden modelleyerek tahmin ettiği ('analysed alternate models using Obama's Clean Power Plan as a point of reference') ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) analysed alternate models using Obama's Clean Power Plan as a point of reference
B) relied upon asthma and premature death statistics
C) targeted all crops including corn, cotton, potatoes, and soybeans
D) adopted models that were different from the Clean Power Plan
E) excluded models based on policies in place before the Clean Power Plan

questions.questionText: 49. What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.explanation: Metnin ana fikri, Temiz Enerji Planı gibi politikaların durdurulmasının mahsul veriminde düşüşe yol açacağı; emisyonları sınırlayan bu tür planların duman oranlarını kontrol etmek ve mahsul verimini artırmak için gerekli olduğudur (Policies like the Clean Power Plan are needed...).
options: A) There is no difference between the Obama plan and other similar plans in reducing emissions.
B) Crop production will continue to shrink under all three plans proposed by researchers.
C) Policies like the Clean Power Plan are needed to control smog rates and increase crop yields.
D) Decreasing carbon dioxide emissions from power plants will necessarily increase crop production.
E) Improving the efficiency of power plants is necessary to control crop production losses.

questions.questionText: 50. Which of the following would be the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: Paragraf, Obama'nın Temiz Enerji Planı'nın (Clean Power Plan) sadece emisyonları azaltmakla kalmayıp dolaylı olarak tarımsal mahsulleri (crop yields) de nasıl kurtarabileceğini anlattığı için, planın önemine ('The Importance of the Clean Power Plan') odaklanmaktadır.
options: A) The Importance of the Clean Power Plan
B) Three Plans for Crop Production
C) Pollution from Power Plants
D) Smog: How Harmful Can It Be?
E) Why is the Obama Plan in Legal Limbo?

questions.questionText: 51. Which of the following is true about ghrelin?
questions.explanation: Ghrelin hormonunun yeni beyin hücrelerinin büyümesini (neurogenesis) teşvik ettiği ve farelere enjekte edildiğinde öğrenme ve hafıza testlerindeki performansı artırarak bilişi geliştirdiği ('can enhance cognitive abilities by triggering the growth of new brain cells') belirtilmiştir.
options: A) It is secreted more when the stomach is full, making people feel sharper.
B) It was originally discovered during research on Parkinson's disease.
C) Its levels drop when we consume fewer calories in a day.
D) It can enhance cognitive abilities by triggering the growth of new brain cells.
E) It primarily functions to delay the effects of ageing on the human body.

questions.questionText: 52. According to the passage, Jeffrey Davies ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Davies ve ekibinin, ghrelin hormonunun beyin hücrelerinin bölünmesini ve çoğalmasını teşvik edebileceğini kanıtladığı ve kaba eklenen hormonun nörojenezi tetiklediği bilinen bir geni 'açtığını' ('switched on a gene known to trigger neurogenesis') bulduğu söyleniyor.
options: A) ended up working on the neurogenesis process by chance when he was working on Parkinson's disease
B) discovered that ghrelin can trigger a gene that plays a role in the multiplication of brain cells
C) was the first scientist to present findings on how ghrelin improves memory at a conference
D) believes his research has finally proven exactly how memory operates in both animals and humans
E) found that animals fed a reduced-calorie diet show fewer signs of neurogenesis

questions.questionText: 53. The underlined phrasal verb 'switched on' in the passage is closest in meaning to ----.
questions.explanation: 'Switch on' (açmak, başlatmak, çalıştırmak) kelimesi burada bir geni 'aktive etmek / tetiklemek' anlamında kullanılmıştır, bu nedenle 'activated' en uygun eşanlamlısıdır.
options: A) activated
B) covered
C) reduced
D) transferred
E) eliminated

questions.questionText: 54. What is the primary purpose of the author?
questions.explanation: Yazarın temel amacı, açlık hormonu olan ghrelinin artan seviyelerinden beyin hücrelerinin nasıl faydalandığını, yani oruç tutmanın beyin gücünü artırabileceği ('boost your brainpower') fikrini ve bunun bilimsel dayanaklarını vurgulamaktır.
options: A) To describe how the neurogenesis process takes place in human brain
B) To highlight that the brain can gain substantial benefits from increased levels of ghrelin
C) To discuss whether ghrelin could be used as a treatment for Parkinson's disease
D) To emphasise the importance of Davies's study on mice and their mental abilities
E) To draw particular attention to the 2017 conference held by the British Neuroscience Association

questions.questionText: 55. It is understood from the passage that first impressions ----.
questions.explanation: Harvard psikoloğu Mahzarin Banaji'nin çalışması, ilk izlenimlerin biz onları terk ettiğimizi düşündükten sonra bile bizi vurabileceğini ('strike us even after we think we have abandoned them') göstermektedir. Bu da onlardan kurtulmanın düşündüğümüz kadar kolay olmadığını (might not be as easy to get rid of) kanıtlar.
options: A) do not shape our lives profoundly when formed quickly and unintentionally
B) might not be as easy to get rid of as we may think
C) may be misleading in job interviews or at social gatherings
D) lose their effectiveness after a certain period of time has passed
E) have such a strong impact on our lives that it is impossible to change them

questions.questionText: 56. What could be concluded from the passage about first impressions?
questions.explanation: Metinde 'akılsız robotlar olmadığımız' ve 'insanların biraz esnekliği olduğu' ('People have some flexibility') belirtilmektedir. Bob ile yapılan deneyler de insanların yeni bilgiler ışığında görüşlerini ayarladıklarını, yani ilk izlenimlerin sonradan değiştirilebileceğini gösterir.
options: A) First impressions about people hardly ever change, positively or negatively even with lots of effort.
B) We do not have any control over our first impressions and cannot change them later.
C) The effects of positive first impressions last much longer than those of negative first impressions.
D) People may sometimes act like mindless robots when it comes to first impressions.
E) We can change our first impressions of others although they are formed unintentionally.

questions.questionText: 57. What can be concluded from the study conducted by Ferguson?
questions.explanation: Ferguson'ın çalışmasında, iyi bilinen birinin kötü bir şey yaptığında imajının anında tersine döndüğü (flips), ancak kötü bilinen birinin çok iyi bir şey yapsa bile tamamen temize çıkmadığı ('They did not flip') bulunmuştur. Yani olumlu izlenimler çok daha hızlı ve kolay değişirken (bozulurken), olumsuz izlenimleri aşmak zordur.
options: A) Positive first impressions about someone are more likely to turn into negative opinions when a bit of negative information is provided.
B) We rely heavily on the negative first impressions we form to a great extent even though they are wrong.
C) Negative first impressions are more likely to change quickly and easily than positive first impressions.
D) Positive first impressions are more likely to change quickly and easily than negative first impressions.
E) People tend to have positive first impressions about others most of the time, but later they may change their mind.

questions.questionText: 58. Which could be the best title for this passage?
questions.explanation: Metin genel olarak ilk izlenimlerin nasıl oluştuğunu ve yeni (özellikle iyi veya kötü) bilgilerle karşılaşıldığında bu izlenimlerin nasıl revize edildiğini / ayarlandığını ('Constructing and Adjusting First Impressions') anlatmaktadır.
options: A) The Lack of Control over First Impressions
B) How to Ward Off Negative First Impressions
C) Different Perspectives on First Impressions
D) Constructing and Adjusting First Impressions
E) Forming Reliable First Impressions

questions.questionText: 59. It can be understood from the passage that Piri Reis's map ----.
questions.explanation: Parçada Piri Reis'in diğer Arap haritalarına ve '4 Portekiz ile bir Kolomb haritasına' danıştığı ('consulted other maps... referred to four contemporary Portuguese maps, as well as one by Columbus') yazmaktadır. Demek ki o dönemde Amerika'yı gösteren tek harita Piri Reis'inki değildi.
options: A) was the first one to include depictions of the Americas
B) was preceded by others that include Africa
C) was not the only map showing the Americas
D) is the first example of a marine map
E) is more accurate than once believed

questions.questionText: 60. It can be understood from the passage that Spanish and Portuguese explorers ----.
questions.explanation: Yeni Dünya rotasının başlarda Atlantik'i keşfeden İspanyol ve Portekizli denizciler tarafından 'gizli tutulduğu ve sıkı sıkıya korunduğu' ('a secret closely guarded by the Spanish and Portuguese navigators') belirtilmiştir. Amaçları başkalarının Amerika'nın yolunu bulmasını engellemekti.
options: A) were initially very open to providing Piri Reis with information
B) wanted to ensure that no others could find their way to the Americas
C) were the only ones exploring the Atlantic
D) were in direct competition with Christopher Columbus
E) worked very closely with monarchies to establish the New World

questions.questionText: 61. The most surprising aspect of Piri Reis's map is that ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Piri Reis'in şaşırtıcı bir şekilde Yeni Dünya'yı (Amerika'yı) Afrika kıtasına göre doğru boylamsal meridyene yerleştirdiği ('surprisingly placed the New World on the correct longitudinal meridian in relation to the African continent') vurgulanmaktadır.
options: A) it was the most complete map of the time
B) the scale was completely different from the previous ones
C) the locations of Africa and Asia were correctly noted
D) his placement of the New World was accurate in relation to Africa
E) it was the first to include longitudinal meridians

questions.questionText: 62. Which of the following is true about Piri Reis and his map?
questions.explanation: Paragrafın sonunda 'Ancak, Piri Reis'in Kolomb'un keşiflerine nasıl eriştiğine dair gizem devam etmektedir' ('The mystery remains, however, as to how Piri Reis gained access to Columbus's discoveries') denmektedir.
options: A) The Americas appeared much larger than Africa and Asia on Piri Reis's map because he basically relied upon Arabic maps.
B) It was impossible that he could have had the same knowledge as Christopher Columbus.
C) There is some doubt about how Piri Reis made use of the discoveries of previous explorers and their maps.
D) Due to the similarity in scale inconsistencies, it is often considered that Piri Reis essentially copied his classical sources.
E) How Piri Reis managed to learn about the discoveries of Columbus is still unknown today.

questions.questionText: 63. Robert: You've persuaded me to volunteer for that organ donation team, but I can't figure out what exactly we're supposed to do. Lee: The team is trying to encourage families to consider how they would feel about donation if they needed an organ transplant when not enough people give their consent. Robert: ---- Lee: Exactly. Surveys show that 30% of people have never discussed organ donation with their friends and relatives.
questions.explanation: Lee takımın asıl amacının, insanları organ bağışını düşünmeye teşvik etmek olduğunu açıklıyor. Robert da 'Anladığım kadarıyla ekip temel olarak insanların bu konudaki farkındalığını artırmaya çalışıyor' diyerek durumu özetlemelidir ki Lee 'Kesinlikle' (Exactly) diyerek anket istatistikleriyle desteklesin.
options: A) So, as far as I understand, the team is basically trying to raise people's awareness about the issue.
B) I see. People are aware of the importance of organ transplantation but most are unwilling to be donors.
C) OK, so non-profit organisations try to ensure that the ethical considerations are understood.
D) Yeah, everybody knows that organ transplantation is a must for those who desperately need organs.
E) I think more and more people are now well-informed about the challenges of the procedure.

questions.questionText: 64. Journalist: So, your company has set up a system that offers online clinical-counselling... Do you think e-therapy is more effective for certain people? Psychologist: ...E-therapy may appeal to people looking for convenience, flexibility and privacy, in particular... Journalist: ---- Psychologist: People have a tendency to think that because you're using an online service, it must be impersonal and can't have the same effect. But it's not true. The difference in results between e-therapy and a face-to-face therapy is quite minimal.
questions.explanation: Psikolog insanların çevrimiçi terapinin 'kişiliksiz (impersonal) olduğuna ve aynı etkiye sahip olamayacağına' dair düşüncelerinin yanlış olduğunu (But it's not true) anlatıyor. Gazetecinin sorusu 'e-terapi hakkındaki en büyük efsane (myth) nedir?' olmalıdır.
options: A) How do you talk to people into participating in e-therapy?
B) Why do you think e-therapy will overtake face-to-face therapy?
C) What is the biggest myth about e-therapy?
D) How long does an e-therapy session work?
E) How does e-therapy help people with a serious mental illness?

questions.questionText: 65. Richard: I saw a video the other day on the Internet about a polyglot. Lucy: A polyglot? What's that? Richard: A polyglot is a person who speaks several different languages. The person in the video I saw speaks eight languages including Portuguese and Chinese. Lucy: ---- Richard: There are some methods used. For example, allocating a few hours a day for a language until mastering it, including intense listening and speaking activities.
questions.explanation: Richard dil öğreniminde kullanılan bazı metotlardan (günde birkaç saat ayırmak, yoğun dinleme ve konuşma aktiviteleri) bahsederek yanıt vermiştir. Buna yol açacak soru Lucy'nin 'Sence böyle insanlar bu kadar çok dili öğrenmeyi nasıl başarıyorlar?' şeklindeki D seçeneğidir.
options: A) Why aren't there more people who can speak many languages like this?
B) What's the minimum number of languages needed to describe someone as a polyglot?
C) Do you think he's completely fluent in all eight of those languages?
D) How do you think such people manage to learn so many languages?
E) How many more languages do you think he can add to his repertoire?

questions.questionText: 66. Sarah: Recently, I've read a magazine article, and it says over the first four years of marriage, spouses report a gradual increase in their willingness to forgive each other. Francis: So, it means they learn to forgive each other as they spend more time together. Sarah: ---- Francis: What do you mean? Sarah: The article says forgiving benefits partners only if the forgiven partner is agreeable and cooperative. If not, he or she tends to offend again.
questions.explanation: Sarah, Francis'in 'demek ki zamanla birbirlerini affetmeyi öğreniyorlar' sözüne karşılık, 'yine de dikkatli olunmalı, çünkü affetmek karşı tarafın kişiliğine bağlı olarak geri tepebilir (can backfire)' minvalinde bir uyarı yapmalıdır ki Francis 'Ne demek istiyorsun?' diyerek açıklama istesin.
options: A) I think anyone who is in a relationship will, at some point, have to decide whether or not to forgive.
B) Well, I believe the worst thing in relationships is mutual trust. If it is broken, you cannot repair it.
C) It's also possible that you don't experience such forgiveness even if someone wants to.
D) One needs to be cautious, though, as forgiveness can backfire, depending on the offending partner's personality.
E) Maybe the reason is that being exposed to situations where forgiveness is required helps one improve that skill.

questions.questionText: 67. Stacy: I'm so bored with my never-ending to-do list. But I can't say I've been able to cross a single item off the list so far. Carole: Maybe you should stop procrastinating and just start working on your list. Stacy: What do you mean? Carole: ---- Stacy: I think you're right, finding another person with the same aspirations will help me take action.
questions.explanation: Stacy'nin son repliğinde 'Haklısın, aynı hedeflere sahip başka bir kişi bulmak harekete geçmeme yardımcı olacaktır' dediği için Carole bir önceki repliğinde hedeflerini/planlarını başka biriyle paylaşmasını (sharing your goals and plans with someone else) tavsiye etmiş olmalıdır.
options: A) I don't get why you've been feeling so desperate about your life plans. You're one of the most ambitious and motivated people I know.
B) Well, I've been seeing a psychologist to deal with the same type of issue. Maybe that's something you can look into as well.
C) Life seems to be getting busier for us modern working women. Maybe keeping a diary of goals you've achieved will help you stay focused.
D) Maybe one way to deal with your problem is just making a habit out of it. I mean you should make a habit of taking action to fulfil your plans.
E) You don't have to keep waiting for the perfect moment. Plus sharing your goals and plans with someone else could be a good idea.

questions.questionText: 68. Mentally healthy adults have a right to refuse medical intervention even if this is likely to result in fatal consequences.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'Zihinsel olarak sağlıklı yetişkinler, ölümcül sonuçlar doğurması muhtemel olsa bile (even if this is likely to result in fatal consequences) tıbbi müdahaleyi reddetme hakkına (have a right) sahiptir' demektedir. C şıkkı 'Tıbbi müdahaleyi reddetmenin olası ölümcül sonuçlarına bakılmaksızın (Regardless of possible deadly results), akıl sağlığı yerinde olan yetişkinlerin bunu yapmaya hakkı vardır (have an entitlement)' diyerek aynı anlamı verir.
options: A) No matter how deadly the results of medical intervention are, mentally healthy adults are choosing to reject it.
B) If they are mentally healthy, adults could reject medical intervention without considering whether or not such an intervention could lead to some tragic outcomes.
C) Regardless of possible deadly results of rejecting medical intervention, adults who are mentally healthy have an entitlement to do it.
D) It is a right for mentally healthy adults to decline medical intervention even when they are aware of possible deadly results.
E) It is possible for mentally healthy adults to consider refusing medical intervention when they are aware of the implications.

questions.questionText: 69. While some people believe that video games are a waste of time, certain games can be a good vehicle for training specific skills, such as enhancing short-term memory, agility or reaction time.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'Bazı insanlar video oyunlarının zaman kaybı olduğuna inansa da (While), belirli oyunlar kısa süreli hafıza vb. becerileri geliştirmek için iyi bir araç olabilir' anlamına gelir. B şıkkında bu yapının iki kısmı 'but' bağlacı kullanılarak yer değiştirmiş ve anlam tam olarak korunmuştur.
options: A) Although some people are convinced that video games are useful in teaching specific skills like improving short-term memory, agility or reaction time, some of them are futile activities, according to some others.

B) Certain video games can be good means for practising some specific skills like improving short-term memory, agility or reaction time, but there are some people who believe that video games are of no use.

C) Some people assume that video games are time-consuming, although they know that certain video games are efficient tools in teaching specific skills like improving short-term memory, agility or reaction time.
D) Video games are thought to be time-consuming; however, they may be beneficial for some people practising certain skills like improving short-term memory, agility or reaction time.

E) There are some people who presume that video games are beneficial in specific skills like improving short-term memory, agility or reaction time; however, those games could be a waste of time indeed.

questions.questionText: 70. Since December 2014, the Breathe Project in the US has been making use of high definition cameras that let residents monitor the air pollution in their cities online.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'Aralık 2014'ten bu yana, ABD'deki Breathe Projesi sakinlerin şehirlerindeki hava kirliliğini çevrimiçi izlemelerine olanak tanıyan (that let residents monitor) yüksek çözünürlüklü kameralardan faydalanmaktadır' şeklindedir. E şıkkı bu ifadeyi edilgen (passive) bir yapıya dönüştürerek eksiksiz aktarır.
options: A) US residents have been contributing to the Breathe Project since December 2014 by monitoring the air pollution in their cities with online use of high definition cameras.
B) In the US, air pollution has been monitored online by the Breathe Project with high definition cameras since December 2014 in order to inform residents about the rates in their cities.
C) Residents can reduce air pollution in their cities using online high definition cameras of the Breathe Project, which was launched by the US in December 2014.
D) High definition cameras used by the Breathe Project in the US since December 2014 help residents combat air pollution in their cities through online monitoring.
E) High definition cameras have been utilised by the Breathe Project in the US since December 2014 to enable residents to monitor the air pollution in their cities online.

questions.questionText: 71. The growing awareness of the impact of job stress is best illustrated by the sheer increase in the volume of job stress research in recent years.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'İş stresi etkisine yönelik artan farkındalık, son yıllarda iş stresi araştırmalarındaki büyük artışla en iyi şekilde gösterilmektedir' demektedir. A şıkkı 'Son birkaç yıl iş stresi araştırmalarının miktarında dramatik bir artışa tanık oldu ve bu, iş stresinin artan şekilde tanınmasını (farkındalığını) en iyi biçimde ortaya koymaktadır' diyerek orijinal anlamı mükemmel yansıtır.
options: A) The past few years have witnessed a dramatic rise in the amount of job stress research, which best demonstrates the increasing recognition of the impact of job stress.
B) The influence of job stress has increased recently, which is best shown by the awareness that has been substantially enhanced by the growth in the amount of job stress research.
C) People are becoming increasingly aware of the volume of job stress research, which has been best illustrated by the recent increase in the influence of job stress.
D) Lately, there has been more research in the field of job stress, which means that it may lead to a higher level of consciousness about the influence of job stress.
E) Although there has been a considerable increase in the number of studies on job stress recently, there is still a need for greater understanding of the influence of job stress.

questions.questionText: 72. It has been a basic tenet that an individual who uses substances heavily will become addicted. There are reports, however, of people becoming addicted to a substance with exposure only once or a few times. Some experts believe people are born with the predisposition to become addicted. ---- Thus, the potential for addiction may be hereditary. On the other hand, a psychological problem may lead the individual into addiction. The need for instant gratification, a feeling of being socially ostracized, and an inability to cope with the downfalls of life have all been cited as possible springboards to addiction.
questions.explanation: Boşluktan önce insanların bağımlı olmaya doğuştan yatkın (predisposition) olduklarından bahsediliyor. Boşluktan sonra ise 'Böylece bağımlılık potansiyeli kalıtsal (hereditary) olabilir' deniyor. Bu mantıksal geçişi sağlayan cümle, E şıkkındaki 'Bağımlı anne babaların çocuklarının kendilerinin de bağımlı olma ihtimali diğerlerine göre daha yüksektir' ifadesidir.
options: A) One characteristic that marks addiction, whether to chemicals or nonchemical practices, is the genetic modification it leads to.
B) A careful medically-controlled withdrawal program can reverse the chemical changes in genes caused by the addiction.
C) Habitual use of an addictive substance can produce changes in body chemistry and any treatment must be geared to a gradual reduction in dosage.
D) Studies have found that many former addicts have enough determination to avoid drugs for the rest of their lives.
E) Children of addicts have a greater probability of becoming addicts themselves than children whose parents are not.

questions.questionText: 73. In almost all cultures and societies, children have collected a broad spectrum of items. Although the activity seems to be universal, very little has been written on this subject. And even though collecting has played an important part in many individuals' lives, it is seldom described in memoirs or autobiographies. ---- This may be because many collections are suddenly abandoned when the collector grows up. Other collections, however, continue into adult life, becoming lifelong passionate occupations; this is especially likely with collections that have some kind of economic value or present the adult with challenges or opportunities for further study.
questions.explanation: Otobiyografilerde nadiren betimlendiği söyleniyor. Sonrasında 'Bunun nedeni birçok koleksiyonun koleksiyoncu büyüdüğünde aniden terk edilmesi olabilir' (This may be because...) deniyor. Bu durumla uyumlu olarak çocuklukta koleksiyonların çoğunun ebeveynler dikkat etmezse parçalanıp kaybolacağını anlatan B seçeneği boşluğu doldurur.
options: A) Most children will carry on adding to their collections throughout adulthood because they are so attached to them.
B) Many are often split up and disappear during childhood unless parents understand the fascinating world of the small collector and pay special attention to saving them.
C) The spirit of the collector, once established, never leaves the individual but is turned in new directions and can result in life-changing career choices.
D) Grand collections may end up in places like museums, which seems to be the dream of collectors who do not want their passionate investments to disappear with them.
E) Collecting trains the eye, creates a sense of order, and develops aesthetic appreciation, while at the same time creating a sense of economic appreciation for certain items.

questions.questionText: 74. Fossils are remnants or traces of an animal or plant of a past geologic age that have been preserved in various ways in the Earth's crust. From earliest times people must have seen fossils, but the first reports we have on the subject are from the ancient Greeks. Xenophanes of the early lonian school is said to have noticed fossilised sea creatures high on mountains; he correctly interpreted this as meaning that these mountains had once been under water. ---- For example, he associated the fossilised bones of large creatures with mythical animals or with giant humans.
questions.explanation: Boşluktan önce Xenophanes'in fosilleri denizle ilişkilendirerek 'doğru yorumladığı' (correctly interpreted) söylenir. Boşluktan sonra ise 'Örneğin dev yaratıkların fosilleşmiş kemiklerini efsanevi hayvanlar veya dev insanlarla ilişkilendirdi' diyerek 'yanlış bir yorumlama' örneği (mitolojik inanç) sunulur. D seçeneği, Herodot'un midye kabukları için aynı doğru sonuca ulaştığını, ancak 'diğer fosilleri yanlış yorumladığını' (misinterpreted) söyleyerek bu örneğe geçişi sağlar.
options: A) In the 17th century, Nicolaus Steno argued persuasively that fossils are remains of living organisms.
B) In Roman times, Suetonius casually mentions that the emperor Augustus kept a collection of large fossil bones in his villa.
C) The famous scholar Avicenna put forward an idea that confused people about fossils for centuries.
D) Later, Herodotus reached the same conclusion regarding fossilized clam shells, but he misinterpreted other fossils.
E) Theophrastus, Aristotle's successor, is said to have written a book on fossils, which was lost later, where he refers to fossilised fish.

questions.questionText: 75. According to a World Bank report in 1993, the East Asian miracle, achieving high economic growth for all people, is due to a combination of fundamentally sound development policies, tailored interventions, and an unusually rapid increase of physical and human capital. The more advanced economies in the Asian region are part of this success and have been referred to as high-performing East Asian economies. ---- In addition, these economies have displayed high per capita incomes, along with a much-improved income distribution, compared with most other developing economies.
questions.explanation: Paragraf, Asya ülkelerinin yüksek ekonomik büyüme mucizesinden ve bunların 'yüksek performanslı' ekonomiler olarak anılmasından bahsediyor. Boşluktan sonra 'Buna ek olarak (In addition), yüksek kişi başına düşen gelire sahiptirler' diyerek bir başka olumlu özelliği sıralıyor. Boşluğa da olumlu bir kayıt/tespit içeren D şıkkı (Bu ekonomiler, yüksek ve sürdürülebilir bir ekonomik büyüme kaydına sahiptir) getirilmelidir.
options: A) In contrast, the dramatic growth of the Asian tiger economies has been based on the export of manufactured goods.
B) Poorer countries have greater difficulty than relatively richer countries climbing up the ladder of development.
C) The study suggests that economies with a strong inward focus could not succeed.
D) Such economies have a record of high and sustained economic growth.
E) Promoting trade is positively related to levels of per capita income.

questions.questionText: 76. (I) In ancient time-measurement systems, including those of both Egypt and China, daylight and night-time were each given 12 hours. (II) This was convenient for use with sundials, which are known from Egypt as early as 1500 BC, although telling the time by the Sun probably predates the first humans. (III) However, because the length of daylight and night-time varies with the season, so did the length of the sundials. (IV) When water clocks came into use, shortly after them, a conflict between the two forms of measurement became apparent. (V) In the 8th century AD, the Chinese began to add primitive but a bit more sophisticated equipment to water clocks.
questions.explanation: İlk 4 cümle eski zaman ölçüm sistemlerinde mevsimlere göre değişen güneş saatleri ile sabit su saatleri arasındaki sürtüşmeyi ve iki ölçüm biçimi arasındaki çelişkiyi (conflict) anlatmaktadır. V. cümle ise MS 8. yüzyılda Çinlilerin su saatlerine gelişmiş ekipman eklemelerine geçerek anlatımın kronolojik ve tematik akışını bozar.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 77. (I) Early world historians concentrated on agricultural civilisations, but must also pay attention to regions that developed different kinds of economies and different organisational structures. (II) The development of agriculture was a radical change in humans' way of life. (III) By providing a dependable source of food, it allowed people to live in larger groups. (IV) Later on, toolmaking technology advanced with the discovery of metal working, which in turn further increased agricultural production. (V) Increased production freed some members of the society to perform other kinds of work and this in turn encouraged a further series of organisational changes we call civilisation.
questions.explanation: II, III, IV ve V numaralı cümleler insanlık tarihinde tarımın gelişimi, üretim artışı, metal işleme aletlerinin icadı ve bunun uygarlığa giden yolda yarattığı değişimleri bizzat 'tarihin akışı' üzerinden nesnel bir şekilde anlatır. (I) numaralı cümle ise 'Tarihçilerin neye odaklandığı' konusundan (historiografi) bahsederek tarihsel olay anlatımından tamamen kopuk bir giriş yapar.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 78. (I) Most non-marine food chains depend on insects. (II) Almost all birds eat insects, and even those that eat seeds as adults still feed insects to their young. (III) If there were no longer any insects, we would not need the 430,000 tonnes of insecticides that are sprayed onto crops every year. (IV) Insects also break down plant matter and help recycle nutrients into the soil. (V) Without any insects at all, most bird and amphibian species would be extinct in two months.
questions.explanation: Paragrafın tamamı böceklerin besin zincirindeki ekolojik önemi, besin kaynağı olmaları ve toprağı geri dönüştürmeleri üzerinedir. (III) numaralı cümlede ise böcek ilacı kullanımına (insecticides) atıf yapılarak konu doğal ekolojik zincirden çıkıp insanların tarımsal kimyasal kullanımına kaymaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 79. (I) In its earlier days, people treated the experience of watching television rather like that of the cinema, but in many ways, television is nothing like cinema. (II) While film is designed to be a public event and its characteristic mode is a complete performance, television is a procession of segments arranged as a series and watched privately or domestically. (III) Communal watching of programmes provides opportunities for displays of family warmth and affection, so television watching may promote strong emotional connections among families and friends. (IV) Contrary to the intense quality of film that receives sustained attention from the audience, television watching is more casual and episodic. (V) Another obvious distinction is that films typically start with a disordered narrative and move through a series of ups and downs to a resolution, but television presents itself as a set of repeated segments which do not always form a unity of any kind.
questions.explanation: Metnin geneli (I, II, IV ve V) televizyon izlemek ile sinema/film izlemek arasındaki yapısal, sanatsal ve mekan kaynaklı farklılıkları (tek parça performansa karşı tekrarlayan bölümler, yoğun dikkate karşı rahat/bölümsel izleme vb.) kıyaslamaktadır. Ancak (III) numaralı cümle, aniden 'ailenin sıcaklığı, bağların güçlenmesi' gibi aşırı romantik bir fayda belirterek konunun yapısal çerçevesinin dışına çıkmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 80. (I) Martin Luther King Jr. was born in 1929 and grew up in the Deep South, a region of America with a history scarred by slavery and racial segregation. (II) An intelligent and deeply religious man, he attended college at the early age of 15 and went on to study theology, receiving his doctorate in 1955. (III) King was inspired by early civil right leaders, such as Howard Thurman, who knew his father and was a trusted mentor. (IV) In 1963, King led the 'March on Washington', a huge event where thousands gathered on the National Mall to hear him speak. (V) He also looked up to Mahatma Gandhi, and was to adopt his teachings of non-violent resistance in his own struggle for equality in the US.
questions.explanation: Paragraf King'in doğumu (I), eğitim hayatı (II) ve felsefesini şekillendiren ilham kaynakları/etkiler (III ve V) üzerinden belli bir biyografik 'ilk dönem/oluşum' sırası izlemektedir. (III) numaralı cümle Howard Thurman'dan aldığı ilhamı anlatırken, (V) numaralı cümle 'Aynı zamanda Mahatma Gandhi'ye de hayrandı' (He also looked up to...) diyerek bu ilham/etki serisini devam ettirir. (IV) numaralı cümledeki 1963 Washington Yürüyüşü bu ideolojik etki akışını kesintiye uğratan sonradan gerçekleşmiş tarihsel bir olaydır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V
